svg.title: Figure 4-4. Heartbeat and timeout chain (WP-S-03 §4.4)
svg.desc: Top: the command path controlsd (100 Hz) to card (100 Hz) to the pandad send thread to the MCU safety_tx_hook to EPS/PCM, with its freshness gates: card sends only while carControl is alive (0.1 s), pandad drops sendcan older than 1 s (required 20 ms, TSR-614), and the MCU has no command-freshness check (required 50 ms, TSR-408). The heartbeat path runs from selfdrived (100 Hz) through pandad main (10 Hz, 0xf3 with engaged = alive and valid and enabled) to the MCU heartbeat counter on the 1 Hz tick. Bottom: timing on a common axis from -0.5 s to 6 s. Scenario 1, heartbeat lost at t = 0: at the baseline the 1 Hz counter reaches 5 ticks and the MCU goes SILENT after 4 to 5 s; the reference build revokes authority at 0.3 s (at most 0.31 s), meeting TSR-407, and since panda c33343b (2026-10-13, all builds) sounds the siren at that revocation when authority was granted, about 0.56 s after the last heartbeat (WP-S-04 T-07a), while SILENT still comes after 4 to 5 s against a required 2 s. Scenario 2, engaged mismatch from t = 0: three 1 Hz ticks give a revoke after 2 to 3 s against the required 0.3 s of TSR-307.
svg.text: Command and heartbeat paths with their freshness limits (top) · heartbeat-loss and engaged-mismatch timing on one time axis (bottom)
t = 0 is the fault in each scenario · the phase of the 1 Hz tick is arbitrary; ticks drawn at t = 0.6 s + n · 1 s as an example
SCENARIO 1 · HEARTBEAT LOST: pandad stops sending 0xf3 at t = 0 (SoC hang, pandad dead)
revoked at 0.3 s (≤ 0.31 s, T-06a) · siren ≤ 0.56 s if engaged (T-07a, 2026-10-13) · SILENT still after 4–5 s (T-06b)
SCENARIO 2 · ENGAGED MISMATCH: 0xf3 continues with engaged = 0 from t = 0 while the MCU grants authority
revoked · unchanged in the ref. build
time since the fault (minor ticks 100 ms)

g.text: range set by the tick phase
